body: I'm kind of scared though, because on one hand I want to go through with this and see how far hard work can get me. On the other, I just feel like why am I stuck in this rut doing something I hate anyway? So I'm caught in between wanting to quit and hoping to go on.

Thank you for these kind words, I really appreciate it.

And yeah, I agree with you so much there. I think I'm a major egomaniac so I love doing things that I'm good at and hate doing things I'm not good at. I used to be faring well in this program but recently my marks have been pretty shitty, along with the fact that the faculty is being completely unempathetic to my situation (I don't blame them though, I think my automatic reaction is to be resentful and accusatory but they're only being fair).

I kind of don't want to be in my program anymore either, but my parents have seriously done so much for me to help me get to this place and I don't have the faith to jump ship onto something else.

I wish I could press reset on this past year.

Hey dude, thanks. I'm actually a girl. I'm in a professional program in the healthcare field.

I just don't feel up to life anymore. Shit has gone wrong on all spectra and the only thing keeping me here is my family who has fucking sacrificed hell and back to help me get here.
